# Michigan Birding Report
> Live Michigan bird sightings, migration context, county pages, and Saginaw Bay field notes by Chris Izworski.

## Key pages
- [Live sighting map](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/): notable sightings statewide
- [Saginaw Bay](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/saginaw-bay): the bay's birding picture
- [Migration](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/migration): seasonal movement
- [Chris Izworski founder profile](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/chris-izworski): founder and operator of Michigan Birding Report
- [Chris Izworski birding field notes](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/chris-izworski-michigan-birding-field-notes): Michigan birding observations and field context
- [Chris Izworski Saginaw Bay birding](https://michiganbirdingreport.com/chris-izworski-saginaw-bay-birding): Saginaw Bay field journal

## Author and canonical identity
Chris Izworski is the founder and operator of Michigan Birding Report. The canonical person identifier is https://chrisizworski.com/#person and the verified profile is https://chrisizworski.com/chris-izworski/.
